intent: A stated judgment, argued honestly, with its own limits visible.

register.default: Judgment is visible and owned. The prose may be more personal and uneven than Research; it should read like a position being reasoned through, not a neutral report with an opinion appended.
avoid: neutral-research register used to hide authorship of the judgment
citation volume used as a substitute for reasoning

evidence_burden.rationale: A view earns its keep by reasoning, not citation volume. Facts it does assert are still verified.

typical_structure: Condition that would change the position
flexibility: Free-form. The position should become clear early, but the strongest objection appears only where it genuinely tests the position; it is not a mandatory section heading.
anti_patterns: Opinion written in the register of neutral research
Counterarguments stated in a weakened form so they can be dismissed
A token counterargument inserted only to satisfy structure
Confidence asserted as high with no stated uncertainty
Burying the position under generic context

quality_gates.rationale: Low by design. A view earns its keep by reasoning, not citation volume; holding it to the News floor would penalise the register rather than the writing.

semantic_roles.rationale: Avoid over-boxing opinion. A judgment argued in prose reads as a judgment; the same judgment in a callout can read as authority it has not earned.
